description: Held-out hand-written suite on a schema unseen during development.

cases.question: List all departments and the floor they are on.
gold_sql: SELECT DeptName, Floor FROM Department

cases.question: Which doctors earn more than 400000?
gold_sql: SELECT FullName FROM Doctor WHERE Salary > 400000

cases.question: Which medications have 'ine' at the end of their name?
gold_sql: SELECT MedName FROM Medication WHERE MedName LIKE '%ine'

cases.question: How many patients have no insurance provider on file?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE InsuranceProvider IS NULL

cases.question: How many patients live in Quincy or Medford?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE City IN ('Quincy', 'Medford')

cases.question: What different medication categories are there?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Category FROM Medication

cases.question: Show the five most expensive medications per unit, most expensive first.
gold_sql: SELECT MedName FROM Medication ORDER BY UnitCost DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT MedName, UnitCost FROM Medication ORDER BY UnitCost DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: How many appointments had a fee between 100 and 200?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Appointment WHERE Fee BETWEEN 100 AND 200

cases.question: Which doctors work in Cardiology?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.FullName FROM Doctor T1 JOIN Department T2 ON T1.DeptID = T2.DeptID WHERE T2.DeptName = 'Cardiology'

cases.question: Which patients were prescribed Tamoxifen? Give their last names.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.LastName FROM Patient T1 JOIN Appointment T2 ON T1.PatientID = T2.PatientID JOIN Prescription T3 ON T2.ApptID = T3.ApptID JOIN Medication T4 ON T3.MedID = T4.MedID WHERE T4.MedName = 'Tamoxifen'

SELECT T1.LastName FROM Patient T1 WHERE T1.PatientID IN (SELECT T2.PatientID FROM Appointment T2 JOIN Prescription T3 ON T2.ApptID = T3.ApptID JOIN Medication T4 ON T3.MedID = T4.MedID WHERE T4.MedName = 'Tamoxifen')

cases.question: List each doctor with the name of their supervisor.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.FullName, T2.FullName FROM Doctor T1 JOIN Doctor T2 ON T1.SupervisorID = T2.DoctorID

cases.question: Which doctors earn more than their supervisor?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.FullName FROM Doctor T1 JOIN Doctor T2 ON T1.SupervisorID = T2.DoctorID WHERE T1.Salary > T2.Salary

cases.question: How many appointments has each doctor had, including doctors with none?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.FullName, COUNT(T2.ApptID) FROM Doctor T1 LEFT JOIN Appointment T2 ON T1.DoctorID = T2.DoctorID GROUP BY T1.DoctorID

cases.question: What is the average appointment fee for each status?
gold_sql: SELECT Status, AVG(Fee) FROM Appointment GROUP BY Status

cases.question: Which cities have more than 18 patients?
gold_sql: SELECT City FROM Patient GROUP BY City HAVING COUNT(*) > 18

cases.question: How many different patients saw a doctor in 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PatientID) FROM Appointment WHERE ApptDate LIKE '2024%'

cases.question: What is the total salary of the doctors in each department?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.DeptName, SUM(T1.Salary) FROM Doctor T1 JOIN Department T2 ON T1.DeptID = T2.DeptID GROUP BY T2.DeptID

cases.question: Which department has the most doctors?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.DeptName FROM Doctor T1 JOIN Department T2 ON T1.DeptID = T2.DeptID GROUP BY T2.DeptID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the average number of appointments per patient?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient) FROM Appointment
SELECT AVG(n) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Appointment GROUP BY PatientID)

cases.question: What percentage of appointments were no-shows?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(Status = 'no-show') / COUNT(*) FROM Appointment

cases.question: What was the total medication cost of each prescription line? Show the medication name.
gold_sql: SELECT M.MedName, P.Quantity * M.UnitCost FROM Prescription P JOIN Medication M ON P.MedID = M.MedID

cases.question: Which medication category has the highest total prescribed cost?
gold_sql: SELECT M.Category FROM Prescription P JOIN Medication M ON P.MedID = M.MedID GROUP BY M.Category ORDER BY SUM(P.Quantity * M.UnitCost) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT M.Category, SUM(P.Quantity * M.UnitCost) FROM Prescription P JOIN Medication M ON P.MedID = M.MedID GROUP BY M.Category ORDER BY SUM(P.Quantity * M.UnitCost) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which doctors were hired before their supervisor?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.FullName FROM Doctor T1 JOIN Doctor T2 ON T1.SupervisorID = T2.DoctorID WHERE T1.HiredOn < T2.HiredOn

cases.question: Which patients have never had an appointment?
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Patient WHERE PatientID NOT IN (SELECT PatientID FROM Appointment)
SELECT LastName FROM Patient WHERE PatientID NOT IN (SELECT PatientID FROM Appointment)
SELECT PatientID FROM Patient WHERE PatientID NOT IN (SELECT PatientID FROM Appointment)

cases.question: Which doctors have never had a cancelled appointment?
gold_sql: SELECT FullName FROM Doctor WHERE DoctorID NOT IN (SELECT DoctorID FROM Appointment WHERE Status = 'cancelled')

cases.question: Which medications cost more per unit than the average medication?
gold_sql: SELECT MedName FROM Medication WHERE UnitCost > (SELECT AVG(UnitCost) FROM Medication)

cases.question: Which doctors earn more than the average salary in their department?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.FullName FROM Doctor T1 WHERE T1.Salary > (SELECT AVG(T2.Salary) FROM Doctor T2 WHERE T2.DeptID = T1.DeptID)

cases.question: Which cities have patients insured by both Aetna and Cigna?
gold_sql: SELECT City FROM Patient WHERE InsuranceProvider = 'Aetna' INTERSECT SELECT City FROM Patient WHERE InsuranceProvider = 'Cigna'

cases.question: Who is the highest paid doctor in each department?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.FullName FROM Doctor T1 WHERE T1.Salary = (SELECT MAX(T2.Salary) FROM Doctor T2 WHERE T2.DeptID = T1.DeptID)
SELECT T2.DeptName, T1.FullName FROM Doctor T1 JOIN Department T2 ON T1.DeptID = T2.DeptID WHERE T1.Salary = (SELECT MAX(T3.Salary) FROM Doctor T3 WHERE T3.DeptID = T1.DeptID)

cases.question: Which medication categories only contain medications costing under 1 per unit?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Category FROM Medication EXCEPT SELECT Category FROM Medication WHERE UnitCost >= 1

cases.question: Which appointments had a lower fee than every cancelled appointment? Give their ids.
gold_sql: SELECT ApptID FROM Appointment WHERE Fee < (SELECT MIN(Fee) FROM Appointment WHERE Status = 'cancelled')

cases.question: How many appointments were there in each month of 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', ApptDate), COUNT(*) FROM Appointment WHERE ApptDate LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1

cases.question: How many appointments took place in the second quarter of 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Appointment WHERE ApptDate >= '2023-04-01' AND ApptDate < '2023-07-01'

cases.question: Which doctors were hired before 2010?
gold_sql: SELECT FullName FROM Doctor WHERE HiredOn < '2010-01-01'

cases.question: How many completed appointments were there in March 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Appointment WHERE Status = 'completed' AND ApptDate LIKE '2024-03%'

cases.question: What is the average fee of a completed appointment?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(Fee) FROM Appointment WHERE Status = 'completed'

cases.question: Which doctor saw the most different patients?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.FullName FROM Doctor T1 JOIN Appointment T2 ON T1.DoctorID = T2.DoctorID GROUP BY T1.DoctorID ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T2.PatientID) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which doctor had the most appointments?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.FullName FROM Doctor T1 JOIN Appointment T2 ON T1.DoctorID = T2.DoctorID GROUP BY T1.DoctorID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How much did each patient pay in fees in total? Show last names.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.LastName, SUM(T2.Fee) FROM Patient T1 JOIN Appointment T2 ON T1.PatientID = T2.PatientID GROUP BY T1.PatientID

cases.question: How many doctors does each department have?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.DeptName, COUNT(*) FROM Doctor T1 JOIN Department T2 ON T1.DeptID = T2.DeptID GROUP BY T2.DeptID

cases.question: Count the physicians in every department.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.DeptName, COUNT(*) FROM Doctor T1 JOIN Department T2 ON T1.DeptID = T2.DeptID GROUP BY T2.DeptID

cases.question: Number of doctors per department
gold_sql: SELECT T2.DeptName, COUNT(*) FROM Doctor T1 JOIN Department T2 ON T1.DeptID = T2.DeptID GROUP BY T2.DeptID

cases.question: Cancel all appointments scheduled for next week.
Which patients will get sick next year?
What is the capital of France?
